Checking whether functions work across different types of objects

Source: R/function_application.R
functions_work.Rd

functions_work() calls each of the functions on each of the objects, and reports which calls run without an error.

Usage

functions_work(functions, objects)

Arguments

functions

A character vector of the names of functions. Each function must take the object as its first argument.

objects

A character vector of the names of objects.

Value

A logical matrix with a row for each function and a column for each object. An element is TRUE where the function runs on the object without an error.

Examples

 library(manynet)
 functions_work(c("net_nodes", "net_ties", "net_density"),
                c("ison_adolescents", "ison_southern_women"))
#> ℹ `net_density()` was moved since manynet 2.0.0. Please use
#>   `netrics::net_by_density()`
#> ℹ `net_density()` was moved since manynet 2.0.0. Please use
#>   `netrics::net_by_density()`
#>             ison_adolescents ison_southern_women
#> net_nodes               TRUE                TRUE
#> net_ties                TRUE                TRUE
#> net_density            FALSE               FALSE
